name: tenant-ramp-features
description: A ten-minute tenant ramp (2, 200, 4000 tenants) for a feature the host leaves off by default. The host environment names the feature (TRACON_CAPACITY_RATE_LIMIT=instance turns the per-tenant endpoint limiter on with a limit nothing reaches; TRACON_CAPACITY_TENANT_TAG turns the per-tenant metric tag on). Compare its levels with the same stages of a run without the feature; the plateaus are short, so only a cost of a few kilobytes a tenant shows. A development profile, not a measurement.
